title: Japanese Merida Scultura Endurance 4000 clearance notice
notes: Retailer notice dated 2023-11-13 names the Scultura Endurance 4000 at a ¥374,000 list price and says to inquire about the sale price. It is a Japan-market historical lead with no exact mapping to the mainland R7000 community build and is not transferable as a China price.
